ysm_scg2_compat.configuration.title: YSM x Scorched Guns 2 Compat
How Scorched Guns 2 weapons are translated into the tac:* gun animations a Yes Steve Model model can play.
ysm_scg2_compat.configuration.enable_gun: Teach Yes Steve Model that a Scorched Guns 2 weapon is a gun, so the model plays its built-in tac:hold / tac:aim / tac:reload animations. Only applied when the model actually contains the animation.
ysm_scg2_compat.configuration.use_per_gu: Prefer tac:hold:rifle$scguns:musket over tac:hold:rifle when the model defines it.
ysm_scg2_compat.configuration.log_model_: Print which tac:* animations the local player's model contains. This is how you tell 'the model cannot do gun animations' apart from 'the mod is not working'.
ysm_scg2_compat.configuration.log_animat: Per-frame log of which animation was matched or declined. Runs every frame - enable only while reproducing a problem.
ysm_scg2_compat.configuration.diagnostic: Measurement only. Nothing here changes behaviour.
ysm_scg2_compat.configuration.log_render: Log which custom item renderer drew the held weapon and the pose-stack translation YSM handed it. Use this to diagnose 'the weapon model does not appear in third person'.
